thread:
lina-support: New onboard for Halcyon Labs (HAL-921). Customer reports API key not visible in their project and calls using the key return 403. Console shows key state "pending-handoff". Can someone triage? claim token `claim_01abC`. Customer repro steps below.

jon: On it. Can you paste exact repro curl + response and provisioning logs?

lina-support: Steps:
1) SSO flow completed
2) Console shows key in "pending-handoff"
3) curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY_FROM_CONSOLE>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models ... returns 403

curl command:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hi"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Response:
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"project_not_bound","detail":"api key not bound to project HAL-921"}
```

Provisioner logs excerpt:
```
[2026-03-15T18:02:41Z] claim=claim_01abC state=staged -> pending-handoff
[2026-03-15T18:03:02Z] handoff attempt to org=halcyon failed: timeout waiting for iam-binding
```

provisioner-bot: note: claim claim_01abC currently in pending-handoff, retry scheduled in 30s :hourglass_flowing_sand:

noah-sre: Looks like an IAM binding race. Could be the role binding step didn't propagate to their project. Are there org policies blocking binder service account?

maya-ops: Flagging ops: I can run a manual reconcile. Lina, can you confirm we have tenant id HAL-921 and it's safe to run `rctl provision reconcile HAL-921`?

lina-support: Confirmed HAL-921. Customer gave permission. Please run.

maya-ops: Running now...
```
rctl provision reconcile --tenant HAL-921 --verbose
```

provisioner-bot: reconcile started for HAL-921
[2026-03-15T18:05:12Z] reconcile: found unstaged claim claim_01abC
[2026-03-15T18:05:18Z] iam-binding: created binding for sa:provisioner@redwood.iam -> project:halcyon
[2026-03-15T18:05:19Z] claim claim_01abC state=pending-handoff -> bound

lina-support: OK got updated console state: key now shows bound and linked to project HAL-921 :white_check_mark:

jon: can customer try call again? If still 403 check they used updated key; sometimes UI caches old token.

lina-support: Customer tested — calls succeed, generate returns 200 and tokens billed to HAL-921. They confirm. I'll close once they ack in support ticket.

halcyon-customer-bot: Customer confirmation: "Thanks, works now" :tada:

lina-support: Closing thread. Root cause: IAM binding race between provisioner and org IAM propagation. Follow-up: add retry/backoff and surface handoff failure to SRE alerts. Filed ENG-PR-482.
